_provenance.what: Per-job VKSTATS telemetry: the last VKSTATS line the server emitted for each job, parsed into its fields.
_provenance.why_this_file_exists: Those server logs were never tracked by git and were deleted during the 2026-09-18 archive reduction, before it was noticed that make_ruler_numbers.py reads them. The values below are the ones the generator had already extracted from those logs into vestigekv_paper/ruler_numbers.tex, which was committed before the deletion; they are the authentic measured values, but the raw logs behind them are NOT retained and cannot be re-derived from this archive. Re-running the jobs in EXPERIMENTS.md regenerates the logs.
_provenance.fields: steps = decode steps counted; fetch_p50/p90/p99 = archived rows fetched per scan; fallback = fraction of scans that fell back to dense.
_provenance.note: fetch_p50 = 4096 is the row-buffer capacity, i.e. the count is at the cap.
